note_en: 并不 is a stronger, more formal "not" than plain 不: it pushes back against an expectation, like "not at all" or "by no means." In 对中国经济的看法却并不一致 "yet their views on China's economy were by no means the same," it contradicts what fifteen years in the same department would lead you to expect. You'll meet 并不 often in analytical and official writing, and paired with 却 it sharpens the contrast with what came before.
